name: Bharti Airtel

snapshot.about: Telecom services provider offering mobile, fixed line, digital, B2B, cloud, data centers, and financial services.

narrative: Management reported robust top-line expansion, with Q1 FY27 revenue reaching ₹58,539 crore, up 18.3% year-on-year, matching claims of ₹58,500 crore. Reported EBITDA margin of 57% aligns with operating strength, while operating cash flow consistently converts reported net profit into cash.

promises.statement: Bharti Airtel aims to expand Nxtra data center operating capacity to over 1 gigawatt in the next few years.

said.quote: The partnership with Google, coupled with the ongoing expansion in Nxtra, gives us a clear visibility to get to over 1 gigawatt in the next few years

actual_source.quote: Our plan is to reach 1 gigawatt capacity in the next three to four years and grow significantly ahead of the market

promises.note: Management repeatedly reaffirmed the 1 gigawatt data center capacity target across subsequent quarters.

promises.statement: Data center capacity planned to reach 1 gigawatt within the next 3 to 4 years.

said.quote: Our plan is to reach 1 gigawatt capacity in the next three to four years and grow significantly ahead of the market

actual_source.quote: In data centers, we continue to make steady progress against our ambition of building 1 gigawatt capacity over the next few years

promises.note: Target of 1 gigawatt data center capacity reaffirmed in subsequent quarterly earnings calls.

promises.statement: Nxtra is targeting building 1 gigawatt capacity over the next few years.

said.quote: In data centers, we continue to make steady progress against our ambition of building 1 gigawatt capacity over the next few years

actual_source.quote: We are working towards our ambition to build one gigawatt in the next few years

promises.note: Data center target of 1 gigawatt capacity was reaffirmed in the Q1 FY27 call.

promises.statement: Capex for the coming year is expected to be in the ballpark of FY2026.

said.quote: So the net result of all of that, if you look at the capex, while we do not give guidance typically, our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit

actual_source.quote: Capex for the quarter was about Rs.13,390 Crores and the operational discipline continues to remain an enabler of our strong performance

promises.note: Capex for Q1 FY27 came in at ₹13,390 crore.

promises.statement: Company plans to build 56 edge data centers in the next 18 to 24 months.

said.quote: we are focused right now on building in the next 18 to 24 months- 56 world class edge data centers

promises.statement: Airtel Money is preparing for a London listing in H2 FY27.

said.quote: Given this growth trajectory and the large addressable opportunity, Airtel Money is now preparing for a London listing in the second half of 2026

cash.read: Profits turn strongly into cash. Over FY22–FY26, cumulative operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore comfortably exceeded reported net profit of ₹100,454 crore.

bull.point: Cumulative operating cash flow reached ₹419,802 crore over FY22–FY26, substantially exceeding cumulative reported net profit of ₹100,454 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹100,454 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Consolidated revenue grew 18.3% year-on-year to ₹58,539 crore in Q1 FY27, with net profit expanding 34.9% to ₹10,012 crore.

evidence.quote: Our consolidated revenue was Rs.58,500 Crores, growing at about 5.7% sequentially

bull.point: Operating free cash flow reached over ₹16,450 crore in Q1 FY27, maintaining strong internal cash generation.

evidence.quote: Our operating free cash flow, which is EBITDAaL minus capex, was at over Rs.16,450 Crores

bear.point: Disputed statutory and tax demands total 47,044 million, posing ongoing regulatory litigation and outflow risks.

evidence.quote: The Company has recognised provisions for probable outflows relating to regulatory matters, as applicable and have disclosed contingencies for regulatory matters where the obligations are considered possible

bear.point: Extensive related-party transactions are conducted with subsidiary Indus Towers Limited for passive infrastructure services and operation maintenance.

evidence.quote: Availing of service(s) including passive infrastructure services and/or related services required for active services viz. IBS, WiFi etc. and/ or services, including but not limited to, of project management

bear.point: Preferential equity allotment of up to 146,761,335 fully paid-up shares to promoter entity Indian Continent Investment Limited increases group exposure to Africa.

evidence.quote: approved a composite transaction comprising issuance and allotment of upto 146,761,335 fully paid-up equity shares of the Company to Indian Continent Investment Limited (‘ICIL’), a promoter group entity
